g.text: Static assets, images, edge cache, edge functions
Frontend: stateless Next.js behind CDN/edge, ISR for listing pages, scale by region
API: containerized (k8s/ECS), autoscale on CPU/request rate, stateless services behind LB
Data: Postgres primary + read replicas, shard by region at scale; Redis absorbs repeat reads
Search & Media: dedicated search cluster updated async; S3 + CDN for global low-latency delivery
Deployment: multi-region, blue/green releases, IaC (Terraform), health-checked rolling updates
